_policy: Maintainer-confirmed ministry rename mappings. Hand-authored, owner-confirmed, never generated.
_decision: Owner decision 2026-10-09 (specs/001-resolved-metadata-layer/spike/ministry-identity.md). ministry_id is the slug of the FIRST name a ministry was seen under: assigned once, never changed, never reused. A rename attaches the new name to the EXISTING id -- the older id is kept, the new name becomes canonical_name, the old one goes to former_names.
_why_not_mincode: /api_ls/question/getMinistry serves minCode, but it is per-term: 10 of the 52 names present in both terms carry a different code, and 14 of the 56 shared codes name a different ministry in each term. Four of those pairs have both names carrying questions simultaneously for years, which is code reuse, not a rename. minCode is not used for identity and is not published.
_evidence_rule: A mapping rests on DATE HANDOFF alone: the old name's last question strictly precedes the new name's first, with no overlap. A shared minCode is NOT evidence -- it was only a candidate rule.
_not_asserted: Table 3 candidates get no mapping (four shared-code pairs overlap in time; COOPERATION began mid-term with no predecessor; three names are merely sparse; PRIME MINISTER has one question). Table 4 names carry zero questions in the window, get no id, are not published, and are counted in the coverage statement.
_normalisation_not_assertion: Trivial spelling variants are resolved by name normalisation, not here: EDUCATION/Education (case) and MICRO, SMALL.../MICRO,SMALL... (punctuation) by the existing slug; COMMUNICATION/COMMUNICATIONS and ENVIRONMENT, FORESTS.../ENVIRONMENT, FOREST... by the singular fold.

renames.evidence: Date handoff: SHIPPING last question 2020-09-22 (144 Qs); PORTS, SHIPPING AND WATERWAYS first question 2021-02-04 (848 Qs). Gap 135 days, no overlap.
Date handoff: HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES last question 2021-03-23 (177 Qs); HEAVY INDUSTRIES first question 2021-07-20 (508 Qs). Gap 119 days, no overlap.

Date handoff: HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT last question 2020-03-23 (888 Qs); Education first question 2020-09-14. Gap 175 days, no overlap. The successor covers BOTH written forms -- 'Education' (2,115 Qs, 17th LS) and 'EDUCATION' (1,586 Qs, 18th LS) differ only by case and already normalise to one id, so the successor side is 3,701 questions.

Date handoff: the long form's last question 2024-02-09 (1,211 Qs); AYUSH first question 2024-07-26 (658 Qs). Gap 168 days, no overlap. An abbreviation, which the singular fold cannot resolve -- hence an assertion.
